loadFailedTitle: The content workbench could not be loaded
loadFailedBody: The data may not be ready yet. Try again in a moment.
dragHint: Drag a post to another day to reschedule it.
emptyMonthBody: Press Plan the month and NIVO suggests ideas by your themes and posting rhythm, or add a post yourself.
setupFirstTitle: Set the themes and rhythm first
setupFirstBody: Planning needs your content themes and how often you post. Add them in Settings.
listEmptyBody: Plan the month or add a post to start.
planBody: NIVO asks OpenClaw for one idea per posting slot, balanced across your themes, with holidays and your real offers. It usually takes one to two minutes. You then accept or edit each idea.
planRunning: OpenClaw is planning. Keep this window open, it can take a couple of minutes.
planDonePast: {n} slots already in the past were skipped.
quickBody: Paste a topic or a few lines. NIVO writes a draft for each channel you pick.
quickTopicHint: For example: new autumn menu starts Monday, or: how to choose a sunscreen
addDateHint: Day/month/year, for example 25/12/2026. Leave empty for no date.
variantEmpty: No text for this channel yet.
mediaUploadBad: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP image or an MP4 video under 50 MB.
mediaLibraryEmpty: The library has no media yet. Upload a picture.
submitted: Sent. It now waits in Approvals.
submitNeedText: Write the text for every channel first.
reopenNote: Back to draft means it needs approval again.
frozenNote: The text is locked while the post waits for approval or after approval. Use Back to draft to change it.
postedBody: Real posting to the networks is coming soon. For now, copy the text, download the pictures, post it yourself, then mark it as posted.
zaloNote: Zalo OA: posting through the official account is not connected yet, so it is copy and paste too.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
postedLinkHint: Pasting the link keeps proof that it went live.
queueEmptyBody: Posts you send for approval show up here. Nothing goes online before you approve it.
queueWhy: Posting is always your decision. NIVO never posts by itself.
queueNoDecision: This post has no open decision. Send it for approval again.
queueApproved: Approved. You can post it from the calendar or the list.
balanceBody: Planned posts per theme against the share you asked for. Skipped posts do not count.
balanceEmpty: No planned posts this month yet.
cadenceBody: Posts planned against what your posting rhythm asks for.
settingsPillarsBody: The groups of content you want to keep in balance. The weight is the share of posts each theme should get.
settingsCadenceBody: Per channel: posts a week, which days and what time (Vietnam time).
settingsBrandBody: NIVO already reads the tone you confirmed in the agent setup. Add anything specific to posts here.
settingsAutoBody: They only write messages in Office and drafts. They never post and never skip your approval.
autoReminderBody: Every morning from 7:00, a message in Office lists what is due today and what is not approved yet.
autoOffer: Draft a post when a new offer is added
autoOfferBody: When a price list or promotion appears in your knowledge, NIVO writes a draft about it for you to approve.
autoSummaryBody: Every Monday from 8:00, a short summary of last week in Office.
readOnly: Only an owner or manager can change this.
